title: Division
description: A Federal Reserve division that can be staffed by the Chair. SPEC-INST-2, SPEC-STAFF-1, SPEC-DIV-2.

id.description: SPEC-INST-2: unique division identifier, used as key in flags/vars.

name.description: SPEC-INST-2: localization key for the division display name (e.g. 'division.research.name').

desc.description: SPEC-INST-2: localization key for the division description.

hire_cost.description: SPEC-INST-2: political capital cost to hire a division head.

investment.description: SPEC-INST-2: abstract investment contribution per unit of staff competence. Feeds SPEC-BRIEF-2 forecast quality.

skill_weights.description: SPEC-STAFF-1: how much each skill dimension matters for this division's effectiveness.

channel.description: SPEC-DIV-2: which economic channel this division's effectiveness feeds.

unlocked_by.description: SPEC-DIV-2: optional tech id that must be researched before this division becomes available. Omit for always-available.
